As you're aware, we have $8,600,000 of cash available for distribution after ordinary operating payments, and the draft proposes a $4,000,000 dividend with no finalized payment date or supporting process terms yet. Before I can authorize anything, I'll need to run this through our normal treasury approval routine — that means getting review and sign-off from liquidity planning, legal, and tax. I'd like to hear from each of you on whether you see any issues with the proposed $4 million distribution and what terms or conditions you'd recommend attaching to the payment.
